items.text: Mariah Carey's "Vision of Love" spent four weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, one of the three longest-running number-one singles of 1990.
items.question: Where were you living when Mariah Carey's "Vision of Love" was on the radio, and who tried to hit her high notes?
items.source_quote: This is a list of the U.S. Billboard magazine Hot 100 number-ones of 1990. The three longest running number-one singles of 1990 are "Nothing Compares 2 U" by Sinéad O'Connor, "Vision of Love" by Mariah Carey, and "Because I Love You (The Postman Song)" by Stevie B, which each attained four weeks at the top of the chart.
